description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for an HTTP endpoint, including hostname, port, and shutdown timeout, along with an enumeration of known config values with defaults.

classes.name: HttpConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying getters for HTTP configuration parameters such as hostname, port, and shutdown timeout.

classes.name: HttpConfig.HttpConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue, representing configuration keys with default values for HttpConfig.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the HTTP endpoint, or an empty string if not configured.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the HTTP endpoint.

methods.name: getCoordinatedShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration after which requests and connections shall be terminated during shutdown.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string for the config value.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the configuration key.
